svg.title: Coral Shelf Road — Coral overhang survey
svg.desc: A broad lower shelf runs beneath living coral arches. Two stair ramps reach tagged survey perches; rope return lines preserve a clear lane around each fight. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops

svg.text: A broad lower shelf runs beneath living coral arches. Two stair ramps reach tagged survey
perches; rope return lines preserve a clear lane around each fight.
7 raised landings · 2 stair flights · 3 rope climbs · 2 ladders · 20 placed props
R = same-map recovery · structural concept, not an exported collision mesh
P1 Shellbell Strand · P2 Terrace Tideway · P3 Nipper Cliffs
Encounter: Silt Skitter · Common; repeatable solo combat AND equivalent aid/repair objective.
